Class Rating

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.Rating
public class Rating extends Object
A buyer's rating/review of a seller after a completed deal.

This is the UML Rating entity. It may be linked to the completed Deal; historical seeded ratings without a known deal keep dealId null (the UML multiplicity is 0..1).
